body:
elaine: quick sync on the observability PRD — we need a final decision on retention tiers vs UX complexity for traces and dashboards. customers are asking for 13/26 month retention windows and we have perf constraints.

devin: can we separate long-term storage from the UI experience? keep 90d live, archive to cold storage for >90d and surface in a different view.

jordan: archiving is fine but customers want search across full-retention span (ad-hoc queries). cold queries will be slower — need SLOs and pricing.

sam: quoting a customer (LargeBank): "we need 1yr searchable traces for audits, plus exportable raw logs" — that's the ask driving priority.

elaine: tradeoffs: a) full-search across 1yr in primary index (high cost, fast), b) archive searchable (slower, cheaper), c) export-only (manual). Which do we take to GA for Dedicated + Private?

rachel: I prefer b for hosted GA, a could be a Dedicated add-on. b keeps product simple and addresses most asks.

devin: agree. for b we need acceptance criteria and UX so customers understand latency/price.

elaine: draft acceptance criteria (quick):
```
- retention tiers: 90d (standard), 1y (archive-searchable), 13/26m (cold-only)
- UI: clear status badge per trace (live | archived | cold) and a toggle to include archived results
- search: archived queries return within 30s for simple filters, 2m for wide scans
- export: CSV/NDJSON export for archived ranges
- billing: per-GB-month for archive + per-query compute surcharge
- security: archived data subject to same KMS + audit logs
```

jordan: add edge cases: partial traces (kv cache eviction), large trace (>10k spans), and cross-model correlation (logs + traces). We should list regression tests.

sam: also add compliance flow: a user request to purge a trace (GDPR) must remove from both live and archive within 24h.

elaine: UX questions: where do we put the archived toggle? in global search or in trace list filters? I worry adding too many toggles in search bar.

rachel: put it in advanced filters, and show a one-time tooltip on GA explaining latency/pricing.

devin: ops-bot: deploy-preview: https://staging.internal/ui/obs/retention-v2 — preview has badge mockups and archived filter in advanced options.

ops-bot: preview deployed by CI (build 2026.04.12-87). link above.

elaine: next steps: 1) product to finalize PRD with these criteria, 2) eng to validate perf numbers for archive queries, 3) security to confirm KMS/retention keys. Tagging owners: @devin, @jordan, @rachel.

devin: I’ll run a perf matrix this week against archive store and post results.

jordan: I’ll add regression tests to the trace test harness and flag span size edge cases.

rachel: I’ll draft the GA messaging and billing FAQ copy.

elaine: final note — if perf looks bad, fallback plan is export-only for 13/26mo and add search in Dedicated roadmap. call this out in PRD.

sam: sounds good. thanks. :thumbsup:

elaine: ok closing this thread — will attach PRD draft later.
